hero.title: Hallimane Restaurant: Bangalore's Authentic Village Dining Experience Awaits You
hero.subtitle: Savor the true taste of rural Karnataka right here in Bangalore, amidst a captivating village ambience that promises authenticity and value.

about.title: Welcome to Hallimane: Savoring Two Decades of Tradition
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a landmark in the culinary map of Bangalore for well over 20 years. Located in a vintage part of Bangalore, the restaurant features a village ambience with its tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings and an abundance of plants; Hallimane has been proclaimed as one of the best ethnic and value for money restaurants in Bangalore by the media.
about.paragraph2: Hallimane is a destination for most Bangaloreans who prefer to savor the best of rural cuisine in a rural setting. The restaurant serves fresh, hygienic and delicious rural food, complemented by exemplary service.
